scope: Packaged Git SSH lookup, explicit command precedence and fail-closed AppStore client resolution

checks.precedence: Real Git with private executable mock clients verifies ordinary bundled lookup, core.sshCommand, GIT_SSH_COMMAND precedence and GIT_SSH selection; literal path spaces and private socket value retained
checks.missing_client: AppStore rejects absent/non-executable SSH; development/external Git compatibility retained
checks.native_receiver: Loads the AppStore embedded Core using build-product module metadata; resolves bundled Git and agent/add; real packaged Git invokes generic ssh -V and emits pinned SSH/OpenSSL versions; expected Git exit 128, no connection
checks.native_loaded_image: dyld image inventory matches the app embedded Core binary after symlink resolution

limitations: No authentication, host-key/password/Keychain, hardware-key or PuTTY-key conversion acceptance
Unsigned app builds and native receiver; no signed sandbox, Intel runtime or macOS 13 runtime acceptance
Version-only native Git call intentionally uses generic GIT_SSH_COMMAND=ssh -V; actual default transport selection is covered by mocked real-Git fixtures
No main app launched; no hosted GitHub CI verification
